name: The St. Regis Deer Valley
positioning: Ski-in/ski-out St. Regis mountain resort in Deer Valley, Park City, Utah, with a private funicular from the lobby to the slopes
best_for: Skiers who want ski-in/ski-out access with a ski valet team
Families or groups wanting multi-bedroom residences with kitchens

facts.text: The hotel's own Deer Hollow trail is steps from the resort, giving ski-in, ski-out access.
A dedicated Ski Valet team prepares guests' gear.
The heated split-level infinity pool is open year-round, with adjacent hot tubs.
The St. Regis Spa sits at 8,000 feet and has a heated indoor pool.
Every spa treatment begins with a personal consultation.
La Stellina is an Italian restaurant with mosaic floors and black-and-white prints.
Brasserie 7452 serves classical French comfort food in a light-filled lounge and suits all ages.
Rooms have electric fireplaces, cable-knit throws, oversized windows and private balconies.
Complimentary yoga is offered each morning, and apres ski is served in the Library each afternoon.
An inclusive house car runs within Park City limits seven days a week.
The hotel has a Topgolf Swing Suite lounge with food and beverage service.
Dogs are welcome, up to two per room and up to 50 pounds each, with a non-refundable pet fee per stay.

highlights.text: A private funicular carries guests from the grand lobby to the slopes.
The pool and two Jacuzzis overlook the Deer Hollow ski run.
Each evening at 5:00 pm, butlers perform Champagne sabrage in the lobby, paired with caviar and Moet Champagne.
The private residences in Deer Valley's Snow Park area have two to four bedrooms, gourmet kitchens and fireplaces in every room.
The St. Regis Wine Vault has two adjacent private Wine Vaults for intimate dinners.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service, and Salt Lake City International Airport is about 42.6 miles away.
Guests must be 18 or older for massages, body treatments and the spa relaxation areas.
